audit_item: A05 / registered R4 experiment-control JSON integrity
finding: The registered R4 hierarchy and E2/E3 runners loaded frozen fold config, preregistered protocol, source-preparation receipt, and archive receipt with default json.loads. Duplicate object keys were silently resolved using the last value, even though the complete bytes were preregistered and hashed.
change: Both registered runners, all five R4 Fold freezers, and the ADA/DOGE/SOL official-archive downloaders now use rles_data.loads_unique_json for persisted controls and receipts, rejecting duplicate keys recursively. The registered runners normalize IO, UTF-8, and JSON syntax failures to ValueError. Added a synthetic nested-duplicate and invalid-UTF-8 regression.

verification.ruff: passed for both runners and test module
verification.mypy: packages qa: 224 source files, no issues; installed untyped-wheel diagnostic disabled

scope: Synthetic temporary JSON only; no market, ledger, Validation, Test, or Holdout data was read. Archive downloaders were linted and compiled but not run; QA-only scripts changed, so no package wheel rebuild was required.
